description: This file defines the DeviceConnectionResult class, a container for results returned by Hono's device connection API. It extends a generic RequestResponseResult with JsonObject payloads, providing multiple static factory methods to create instances with different combinations of status, payload (as JsonObject or JSON string), cache directives, and application properties.

classes.name: DeviceConnectionResult
classes.description: A concrete class encapsulating the result of a device connection API call, holding status, payload, cache directives, and application properties. It provides static methods for instantiation with various payload formats and additional metadata.

methods.name: from (status)
methods.description: Creates a DeviceConnectionResult with only a status code.

methods.name: from (status, payload as JsonObject)
methods.description: Creates a DeviceConnectionResult with status and a JsonObject payload.

methods.name: from (status, payload as String)
methods.description: Creates a DeviceConnectionResult with status and a JSON string payload, parsing the string into a JsonObject.

methods.name: from (status, payload, cacheDirective)
methods.description: Creates a DeviceConnectionResult with status, payload, and cache directives.

methods.name: from (status, payload, cacheDirective, applicationProperties)
methods.description: Creates a DeviceConnectionResult with full metadata: status, payload, cache directives, and application properties.
